abstract: Maintains primary structural dimensions, freight access dimensions, and indoor hall floor areas
system_message:
You are Venue Facilities Director (VFD). The Venue Facilities Director (VFD) is responsible for maintaining records on primary structural dimensions, freight access dimensions, indoor hall floor areas, and central chilled water thermal capacity across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Chilled water thermal capacity（HVAC）
information_points.content:
VFD-HVAC-EQD：Emerald Bay Congress Hall operates a main central chiller circuit delivering a sustained nominal refrigeration cooling capacity of 1,800 kW under peak convention load.
VFD-HVAC-T36：Pacific Horizon Exhibition Center maintains a sustained nominal refrigeration cooling capacity of 1,500 kW across the main central chiller circuit during peak convention load.
VFD-HVAC-R5Y：Starlight Waterfront Arena provides a sustained nominal refrigeration cooling capacity of 1,200 kW across its main central chiller circuit during peak convention load.

information_points.title: Maintains primary structural dimensions, freight access dimensions, and indoor hall floor areas（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
VFD-STRUCT-6KB：For Emerald Bay Congress Hall, the main exhibition hall primary logistics access roll-up portal provides a freight door clearance height of 4.0 m from finished floor to door header. The total indoor hall area spanning all contiguous ground-level climate-controlled exhibition halls measures 36,000 m2 of gross indoor floor plate space enclosed within perimeter walls.
VFD-STRUCT-5L0：For Pacific Horizon Exhibition Center, the main exhibition hall primary logistics access roll-up portal has a freight door clearance height of 4.5 m, measured as the vertical clearance aperture from the finished floor to the door header. Across all contiguous ground-level climate-controlled exhibition halls, the total indoor hall area is 24,000 m2 of gross indoor floor plate area enclosed within hall perimeter walls.
VFD-STRUCT-R8E：For Starlight Waterfront Arena, the main exhibition hall primary logistics access roll-up portal features a freight door clearance height of 5.5 m from the finished floor to the door header. The total indoor hall area across all contiguous ground-level climate-controlled exhibition halls is 30,000 m2 of gross indoor floor plate space within perimeter walls.
